title: Nope.avi
blurb: Flat, final, and delivered in a Texas drawl by the Team Fortress 2 Engineer, who has clearly already thought about it. Nope.avi is one of the earliest immortal shitposts on YouTube — a single word, a single frame, no elaboration whatsoever — and it established a whole grammar of minimal refusal that the internet still uses. Play it at requests, at dares, at Mondays, and at anything else deserving a one-word veto with no accompanying reasoning. A genuine founding document of meme audio, and still the most efficient no available.
origin: The Engineer's 'nope' from Team Fortress 2, immortalized by nope.avi.
